request.title: Request a refund
request.copy: The OpenG7 team reviews each request individually. Sending a request does not confirm approval or the return of funds.
request.emailAlternative: You can also write directly to
request.privacy: Do not send card numbers, security codes, passwords or private follow-up links. Share payment information only with support, never in a public space.

reference.title: Find your payment
reference.copy: Find your OpenG7 reference in the confirmation email or on the support page. If you cannot find it, provide the approximate payment date and amount.

contact.title: Explain your request
contact.copy: Write to contact@openg7.org, preferably from the email address used for payment. Include the reference, the reason and the requested amount if you are asking for a partial refund.

decision.title: Follow up with the team
decision.copy: After reviewing the request, OpenG7 may approve, decline or ask for more information. Approval and receiving the refund in your account are separate steps.

nature.title: Nature of contributions
nature.copy: Contributions to the Builders Fund support OpenG7 infrastructure and development. OpenG7 is an independent project in development.

items.nonCharity: OpenG7 is not presented as a registered charity.
items.noReceipt: No official charitable donation receipt is issued. A payment confirmation or sponsorship invoice is not a charitable tax receipt.
items.voluntary: A personal contribution is voluntary support. A business sponsorship also follows the review and visibility conditions below.

payments.title: Payment and confirmation
payments.copy: Payment takes place through Stripe’s secure checkout. Your contribution status is updated after Stripe confirms the payment.

items.stripe: Stripe processes card details. Do not email them to OpenG7.
items.currency: Contributions offered on this platform are in Canadian dollars (CAD). Check the amount and currency shown before paying.
items.confirmation: Returning to the site after payment does not by itself confirm a contribution. Its status and public totals may take a little time to update.

refunds.title: Refund review and follow-up
refunds.copy: Requests are reviewed on a case-by-case basis, using the payment record and the circumstances explained to support.

items.request: Contact us as soon as you notice a problem, such as a duplicate payment, an incorrect amount or an issue with a sponsorship. These examples do not guarantee approval.
items.review: OpenG7 may approve, decline or ask for more information. Contact support with your reference to follow up on the review.
items.amount: Specify whether you are requesting a full or partial refund. Contact support about the amount covered by the decision and any fees; this page does not set an automatic flat deduction.
items.destination: When Stripe issues a refund, it goes back to the original payment method.
items.timing: Once the refund has been issued, Stripe generally estimates about 5 to 10 business days for the credit to appear on your statement, depending on your bank. This estimate excludes the initial review of your request and is not a guarantee.
items.retry: If the credit has not appeared after that time, or you are told the refund failed, contact support again with your reference. A refund issued shortly after payment may instead appear as a reversal of the original charge.

disputes.title: Payment disputes
disputes.copy: A dispute with your card issuer is a separate process from a request to OpenG7 support.

items.stripe: If a dispute is already open, let support know so the team can take the ongoing process into account.
items.visibility: Public visibility linked to the payment may be suspended while the dispute is reviewed.
items.records: Information needed to follow up on the payment and dispute is kept to verify transactions and their history.

sponsorship.title: Business sponsorships
sponsorship.copy: Paying for a sponsorship does not publish it. The team reviews the information submitted through the follow-up form.

items.review: The team may approve, decline or ask for revisions to the presentation.
items.followup: Your private follow-up link lets you complete your file and check its status. You can request a new link from the support page if needed.
items.noAutomaticPublication: The logo, message, website and associated posts remain private until review and subject to the applicable consent.
items.refusal: If a sponsorship is declined after payment, contact support to follow up and discuss a possible refund request. Declining publication does not by itself confirm a refund; refunds receive a separate, case-by-case review.

visibility.title: Visibility and publications
visibility.copy: OpenG7 retains editorial control over public sponsor presentations.

items.approval: A reviewed and approved sponsorship may appear on the sponsors page, subject to the applicable consent.
items.removal: OpenG7 reviews content in context. Editorial decisions concern the reviewed items and may request a correction, place review on hold, reject an item or remove public content. Disagreement or controversy alone does not justify rejection.
items.feed: Facebook and LinkedIn posts depend on the benefits associated with the sponsorship and preparation managed by the team. Payment does not publish them automatically.

privacy.title: Privacy and public data
privacy.copy: Fund transparency relies on aggregated information and limits the personal data that is published.

items.publicData: Public names, individual amounts and sponsorships are displayed according to the applicable consent and review rules.
items.privateData: Email addresses, Stripe identifiers and payment details are not displayed publicly.
items.aggregate: Totals, fees and estimates may remain public in aggregate form.
items.contact: Contact support with questions about your data or requests concerning your public presentation. Removing a public presentation does not delete records needed to follow up on transactions.

pending.question: My payment is pending. What should I do?
pending.answer: Returning from the payment page does not by itself confirm a contribution. Check its status using your reference. If the wait continues, email OpenG7 with that reference before making another payment.

email.question: I haven’t received an email. What should I do?
email.answer: Check your spam folder and the address used during payment. You can request your reference below, or a new private link in the sponsorship section. If no message arrives, contact OpenG7.

invoice.question: I can’t find my sponsorship invoice.
invoice.answer: Check the email received after payment, including your spam folder. For help with your sponsorship invoice, contact OpenG7 and include your reference if you know it.

refund.question: How can I request a refund?
refund.answer: Read the usage and refund policy, then email contact@openg7.org with your reference if you know it. The team will review your request; submitting it does not confirm a refund.

method.title: Calculation method
method.copy: The net reflects confirmed payments, after recorded fees and refunds. It is neither the bank balance nor the remaining budget after operating expenses.
method.formula: Contributions − recorded fees − refunds = net before expenses
method.payouts: Stripe payouts transfer money to the bank account: they are not deducted again as expenses.
method.limits: Fees that are not yet available may change the net. Disputes are not detailed separately in this projection. In Stripe-direct mode, refunds belong to the original payment month.

privacy.title: Integrity and privacy
privacy.copy: The registry and exports contain financial aggregates. Contact details, bank data, payment references and administrative notes remain private. Allocation evidence links to public publications.

reports.title: Exports and reports
reports.contents: CSV: monthly aggregates. JSON: period aggregates, with cumulative totals only when all periods are selected. Currency, source and dates accompany the data.
